about_the_game:
The Case of the Bound Entity

A Detective’s Descent into Darkness

Shadow Mansion 2 is a first-person psychological horror and forensic investigation experience that directly continues the unresolved events of the first case. This is not a game of cheap scares or scripted shocks it is a methodical descent into a failed containment, where the mansion itself preserves the evidence.

After your grandfather’s death, you inherit an isolated estate that functions as a vast, silent crime scene. To survive, you must step into the role of an occult investigator, deciphering cryptic journals, fragmented recordings, and disturbed environments to trace the presence bound to the mansion’s very lifeline: its electrical system.

The entity is not merely haunting the house.
It is wired into it.

Key Investigative Features

🔍 Systemic Investigation
Explore abandoned wings, sealed basements, and subtly shifting hidden passages to uncover critical evidence. Understanding how the entity was originally contained and why that containment collapsed requires careful observation and logical reconstruction, not trial and error.

🧩 Environmental Deduction & Reconstruction
The story is never told outright it is rebuilt. Your grandfather’s notes, tapes, and personal effects form a living case file, guiding you through layered environmental puzzles that reveal the mansion’s suppressed history piece by piece.

⚡ Tactical Surveillance & Power Management
Electricity is both your greatest tool and your greatest risk. Restore power, reroute circuits, and manipulate lighting to expose hidden details but every activated light draws the attention of the presence you are trying to study. Illumination is never free.

👁️ Behavioral Pattern Analysis
There is no combat. Survival depends on thinking like a professional investigator. Track environmental disturbances, shifting sounds, and subtle spatial changes to map the entity’s behavior and predict its movements before it finds you.

⌛ Dense, Focused Narrative Experience
Designed as a tightly crafted 2–3 hour investigative descent, every door opened and every decision made pushes you closer to a final, irreversible deduction.

The Mansion Remembers Everything

You may have escaped the first case but the evidence never left.

The mansion remembers every failure, every ritual, every broken safeguard.
The only question is whether you will connect the final pieces…
or become part of its permanent archive.
detailed_description:
You never left us alone

Hello everyone!

Shadow Mansion 1 was never just a game for us – it became a massive school. During that infamous “Mega Update” period, we rebuilt the game from the ground up with your feedback. You got angry at us, you criticized us, but most importantly, you never left us alone.

And we kept our promise: We didn’t abandon the game.

Now we’re taking all the experience we gained in that brutal process, the solid tech backbone we built, and everything that made us say “we’ve finally learned our lesson”, and carrying it all into Shadow Mansion 2.

The fear is the same, but this time, the technology is on our side.

Here’s an honest list of what awaits you in Shadow Mansion 2 (and what won’t be waiting for you):

🛠️ We Learned Our Lesson: Tech Foundation & Controls

We know what happened at the launch of the first game. This time, we’re prepared:

  • 🐭 No More Wrestling With Your Mouse: The era of “sluggish mouse controls” is over. The mouse has stopped acting up; when you turn it, that’s exactly where you’ll look. (Promise.)

  • 🔥 Your GPU Is Safe: We’re not going to push your RTX 4090 to 100% for no reason while you’re just sitting in the menu and turn your room into an oven. Optimization is a real priority this time. 😅

  • 🚪 The Softlock Nightmare Is Over: No more fear of “not being able to finish the game.” You’ll actually be able to see the ending. (Yes, for real this time.)

  • 💥 “Daddy” Has Calmed Down: No more surprises like the game crashing during the “Come to Daddy” scene. We hunted down the bugs and left only the fear behind.

👁️ Not Jumpscares, Pure Atmosphere

We know: screaming faces thrown at the screen are a cheap trick.

  • Shadow Mansion 2 is built on silence, darkness, and psychological pressure.

  • We’ll get under your skin not with sudden noises, but with that uneasy breath you feel on the back of your neck.

🎨 Handcrafted With Care

  • No AI-Generated Visuals: Just like we cleaned them out of the first game, they’re not here either. Everything you see is crafted by our art team.

  • A Fuller, Living House: No empty rooms, no endlessly repeated props. A mansion where every corner feels lived in.

⌛ Short, Sharp, Intense

We’re not promising you a 100-hour RPG.

  • A focused 2–3 hour

    experience you can finish in a single sitting, with a pace that never lets up.

  • No filler content – just story and tension.

❤️ Moving Forward With the Community

We brought Shadow Mansion 1 back to its feet with your feedback. We’re building Shadow Mansion 2 on top of those solid foundations.

This house is far more dangerous than the first one. But don’t worry – our technical infrastructure is much safer now.

The mansion doors are opening once again. Ready to turn the power back on (and have the game not crash)?

Add it to your Wishlist! 🌙👁️

  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i3-4340 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 670 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 or AMD Radeon™ HD 7950
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 970 / NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1660 or AMD Radeon™ R9 390 / AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: The mansion your grandfather left you is more than an inheritance. When the power comes on, not only the lights awaken, but the darkness buried inside. Shadow Mansion 2 is a first-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere, exploration, and stealth.
